free_tier.stated: The programme is offline. The domain now returns, quoted: 'This page doesn't exist - It may have been moved, removed, or never existed. 404 DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND', which is a Vercel deployment error rather than a page. The archived version from 2021 states the scope, quoted: 'Funding for scientists at academic institutions working on COVID-19 related projects.' That sentence is also the reason the programme is out of lane: it funded COVID-19 bioscience at academic institutions, not compute.
